questions.concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
questions.question: 40 liters of mixture contains 10% alcohol and the rest is water. If 4 liters of water is added to it, the percentage of alcohol in the new mixture will be _______.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Total mixture = 40 liters

Alcohol = 10%

**Calculation**

The quantity of Alcohol initially = 10% of 40 = 4 liters 

The quantity of mixture after adding 4 liters of water:

= 40 + 4 = 44 liters

The percentage of alcohol in the new mixture:

= 4/44 × 100 = 100/11 or 9(1/11)%.

**The answer is 9(1/11)%.**

questions.question: A policeman starts chasing a thief from a distance of 600 metres. The speed of the policeman and the thief are 12 km/h and 10 km/h respectively. How long will it take for the thief to be caught?
questions.solution:
Given:

A policeman notices a thief from a distance = 600 m.

A policeman runs at the rate of 12 km/hr

And thief run at the rate of 10 km/hr

Formula used:

Distance = speed x time

Calculation:

Relative speed = (12 - 10)km/hr = 2 km/hr

Time = 600/(2 × 5/18)

⇒ 1080 sec = 1080/60 = 18 minutes

∴ The answer is 18 minutes.

questions.question: If the ratio of radius and height of a cylinder is 3 ∶ 2 and radius is 21 cm, then find the curved surface area (in cm²). (use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Given:

The ratio of the radius and height of the cylinder = 3: 2

Radius = 21 cm

Formula used:

The curved surface area of the cylinder = 2πrh

Here,

r = radius

h = height

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44bdd8cc86a51c6f1552e2e6acc3e991d337017512b65cf94c2911eda8c27424.png] 

Let the radius of the base and height of the cylinder be 3x and 2x

So,

3x → 21

2x → 21/3 × 2 = 14

Curved surface area = 2π × 21 × 14

 

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 21 × 14

⇒ 2 × 22 × 21 × 2

⇒ 1848

∴ The curved surface area (in cm2) of the cylinder is 1848.

questions.question: The radius of a cylindrical vessel is increased by 50% and the height is reduced by 50%. How much will its volume change?
questions.solution:
Given:

Increase in radius = 50%

Reduction in height = 50%

Formula used:

The volume of a cylinder = π r² h

Where r = Radius of the cylinder, h = Height of the cylinder

Calculations:

Let the radius be r and the height be h

Old volume of the cylinder = π r² h

After the change,

Radius = r + 50r/100 = 1.5r

Height = h - 50h/100 = 0.5h

New volume = π (1.5r)² × (0.5h) = 1.125 × π r² h

Increment in volume = [(1.125 × π r2 h - π r² h)/ π r² h] × 100

⇒ [(0.125 × π r² h)/ π r² h] × 100

⇒ 12.5%

∴ The volume is increased by 12.5%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

Let, radius = 10 cm, height = 10 cm

Initial volume = π × 100 × 10 = 1000π cm3

After the change, radius = 15 cm, height = 5 cm

New volume = π × 225 × 5 = 1125π cm³

Increment in volume = [(1125π – 1000π)/1000π] × 100

⇒ (125π/1000π) × 100 cm3

∴ The increment in volume is 12.5%

questions.question: 14 men can build a wall 55 m long in 5 days. How long can 21 men build that wall in 4 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

14 men can build a wall 55 m long in 5 days.

Formula used:

(M₁ × T₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × T₂)/W₂

Where M₁ and M₂ is numbers of men

T₁ and T₂ is Time taken to complete the work

W₁ and W₂ is the work done

Calculation:

Applying the above formula

⇒ (14 × 5)/55 = (21 × 4)W₂

⇒ W₂ = 84 × 11/14

⇒ W₂ = 66 m

∴ The required length of the wall will be 66 metre

questions.question: R buys two cars at the same price. He sells one car at a profit of 12% and the other car at a loss of 8%. Find the total percentage of his profit or loss.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the Cost Price (CP) of two articles is the same, the net profit or loss percentage is the average of their individual profit or loss percentages.

Net Profit or Loss % = (P₁ + P₂) ÷ 2

⇒ Net % = (+12% − 8%) ÷ 2

⇒ Net % = +4% ÷ 2 = +2%

Since the sign is positive, there is an overall profit of 2%.

**∴ The correct answer is 2% Profit.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Profit on the 1st car = 12%

Loss on the 2nd car = 8%

Cost Price (CP) of both cars is the same.

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the CP of each car be 100.

⇒ Total CP of both cars = 100 + 100 = 200

⇒ SP of the 1st car (at 12% profit) = 100 + 12 = 112

⇒ SP of the 2nd car (at 8% loss) = 100 − 8 = 92

⇒ Total SP of both cars = 112 + 92 = 204

questions.question: The ratio of gold and copper in 60 grams of alloy is 2 ∶ 1. How much more copper should be added to make the ratio 1 ∶ 2?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial Ratio of Gold to Copper = 2 ∶ 1 (Total = 3 units = 60 Grams ⇒ 1 unit = 20 Grams)

Final Ratio of Gold to Copper = 1 ∶ 2

Since Gold remains unchanged, equate the Gold units by multiplying the final ratio by 2 ⇒ 2 ∶ 4

Increase in Copper = 4 − 1 = 3 units ⇒ Added Copper = 3 × 20 = 60 Grams.

**∴ The correct answer is 60 Grams.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total weight of initial alloy = 60 Grams

Initial ratio of Gold to Copper = 2 ∶ 1

Final ratio of Gold to Copper = 1 ∶ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b523351719fb513b3f3584e10277eef6c6d206013274e9d2dd8dd433d15a7bbf.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the initial weight of Gold be 2x and Copper be x.

⇒ Total initial weight = 2x + x = 60

⇒ 3x = 60 ⇒ x = 20 Grams

⇒ Initial quantity of Gold = 2 × 20 = 40 Grams

⇒ Initial quantity of Copper = 20 Grams

Let y Grams of pure copper be added to the mixture.

⇒ New quantity of Copper = (20 + y) Grams

Since the new ratio of Gold to Copper is 1 ∶ 2:

⇒ 40 / (20 + y) = 1 / 2

⇒ 20 + y = 80

⇒ y = 60 Grams

**∴ The correct answer is 60 Grams.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Element Concept

When only one component of a mixture is altered (added or removed), the absolute quantity of the other component remains unchanged. Equating the constant component's parts across the initial and final ratios provides the fastest way to solve mixture problems.

Rule of Alligation

Used to find the exact ratio in which two distinct mixtures must be mixed. Formula: (Quantity of cheaper ÷ Quantity of dearer) = (Price of dearer − Mean price) ÷ (Mean price − Price of cheaper).

Replacement Formula

If from a vessel containing x units of a pure liquid, y units are drawn out and replaced with water, and this process is repeated n times, the amount of pure liquid left = x × (1 − y/x)ⁿ.

questions.question: If the surface area of ​​a sphere is 30,184 cm², find its volume (use π = 22/7).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area = 4πr² = 30,184 cm²

r² = 30184 ÷ (4 × 22/7) = 343 × 7 = 2401 ⇒ r = 49 cm

Volume = (Surface Area × r) ÷ 3 = (30184 × 49) ÷ 3

In terms of options: Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 49 × 49² = (88 × 7 / 3) × 49² = (616/3) × 49²

**∴ The correct answer is 616/3 × (49)² cm³.**

Volume and Surface Area of Hemisphere

For a hemisphere of radius r, Volume = (2/3)πr³, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Relationship between Volume and Surface Area of Sphere

The Volume (V) of a sphere can be expressed in terms of its Surface Area (S) as V = (S × r) ÷ 3.

Archimedes Principle for Sphere

The volume of a sphere is two-thirds the volume of its circumscribing cylinder with the same radius and height.</p

questions.question: Find the largest three digit number divisible by 3, 12, 24 and 36.
questions.solution:
**Calculation**

The greatest three digit number = 999

To find the divisible number, an LCM of given four numbers is required,

Factors of 12 = 3 × 4 = 2² × 3

Factors of 3 = 3 × 1

Factors of 36 = 4 × 9 = 3² × 22

Factors of 24 = 3 × 8 = 3 × 2³

LCM of (3, 12, 24 and 36) = 2³ × 3² = 72

On dividing 999 by 72, the remainder 63,

∴ Largest divisible number = 999 – 63 = 936

**The answer is 936.**

questions.question: A thief running at a speed of 7 km/h is chased by a policeman, whose speed is 8 km/h. If the thief is 85 m ahead of the policeman, how much time will it take for the policeman to catch the thief?
questions.solution:
Given:

A policeman notices a thief from a distance = 85 m.

A policeman runs at the rate of 8 km/hr

And thief run at the rate of 7 km/hr

Formula used:

Distance = speed x time

Calculation:

Relative speed = (8 - 7)km/hr = 1 km/hr

Time = 85/(1 × 5/18)

⇒ 17 × 18 sec = 306 seconds

= 306/60 = 5.1 minutes

∴ The answer is 5.1 minutes.
